About me

Practical security research, supported by AI.

My goal is to use AI as a research assistant for exploring code, forming vulnerability hypotheses, prioritising findings, and understanding possible fixes—then verify each result through evidence and controlled testing.

My long-standing interest in computers includes Android phones, bootloader unlocking, ADB, Fastboot, rooting, and custom ROMs. I am now building a stronger foundation in application security and ethical hacking.

How I approach learning

I begin with a clear security question, inspect the application and its behaviour, use AI to explore code and form vulnerability hypotheses, then validate each idea in a controlled lab. I document evidence, assess impact, and investigate possible fixes instead of treating AI output as proof.
